**Chinese name:** 上海复旦微电子集团股份有限公司 (Fùdàn Wēidiàn)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Flagship of domestic FPGA independence — its parts underpin satellite, power-grid and telecom infrastructure — and the highest-profile pure-commercial design victim so far of US controls: added 12 September 2025 with Footnote 4, hitting fabs, EDA and IP outputs simultaneously. The forced pivot (strategic wafer/tooling stockpile grew from ~¥600m 2020 to ~¥3.1bn by H1 2025) paid off handsomely under scarcity: FY2025 revenue ¥39.82亿 (+10.9%), H1 2026 net profit ¥8.49亿 (+338.6%) with FPGA line ¥13.16亿 (2025, +16%).
:::

## What does this firm design?

FPGAs/PSoCs/RF-FPGAs/FPAI programmable-AI chips + EDA, secure-identity/smartcard ICs, non-volatile memory, smart-meter MCUs.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 1998 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | FPGA family (million-gate 28nm mainstream, billion-gate FinFET, RF-FPGA, PSoC, FPAI), security/ID chips, EEPROM/NOR/SLC NAND, metering MCUs; test via 华岭股份 |
| **Node Sophistication** | 28nm CMOS mainline; 1x-nm-class FinFET products in customer intro; 2.5D packaging; FN4 constraint blocks foreign tools/output at advanced nodes |
| **Entity List** | Yes — US Commerce BIS (Entity List, Footnote 4) |
